instrument: Coastal Community United et al. v. City of Statesboro and 4 AM Development, SUCV2026000219 (Bulloch Co. Sup. Ct.)
summary: Petition filed Sept 17 challenges rezoning RZ 26-07-05 of 26.49 acres at 6539 Burkhalter Road from R-4 residential to office/business for a data center campus reported at 99 MW. City served Sept 21 with 30 days to respond.
notes: Petitioners argue the project sits at the hyperscale threshold the city's ordinance was meant to exclude (Strisker). Ordinance 2026-01 defines hyperscale by acreage (over 50 acres); the site is 26.49 acres. 4AM applied to Georgia Power for up to 99 MW (developers).
